page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head and page number at the top. Section number "30. II." at the bottom right, below the last line. Thin printer's ornaments at the right edge, not text.

main_text.l: fidere in Deo debere, quod nempe Deus præstet,
quod ipsius est; & ad omnes hos actus,
paratum esse propensumque Deum, præstan-
dos, nisi ipse sibi homo deerit. Nugæ vanissimæ:
quid hoc est, nisi homo deerit? At an non
credendum, Deum efficere per gratiam,
ne homo sibi ipsi desit? egregia fides & spes;
Deus efficiet ut homo in fidei, spei, & cha-
ritatis actibus perseveret, siquidem ipse per-
severârit. At ipsaest fidei & spei vacil-
latio, ne ego mihi deero: quomodo
tum in Deo fiderem & in ipsius poten-
tissima gratia, ne mihi desim? An fiden-
dum Deum adjuvare me, ne mihi desim, si
non ipse mihi deero? Heu vana solatia, vana
& ludicra spes! At hoc est mysterium, non
esse fidendum mihi in Deo & ejus gratia, quâ
ad finem perseverem in data gratia. At con-
trarium habetur 1. Cor. 1. 8. Philip. 1. v. 6.
29. 10. Evertit omnem folidam confola-
tionem & patientiam sanctorum in illis malis,
quæ ipsis à causis liberis eveniunt, si à li-
bero arbitrio sit efficacia determinationis causæ
liberæ. Frustra enim me Deo submitterem
ob odia, contumelias, & injurias, quæ li-
berè inferunt mihi homines, si Deus ipsorum
voluntates influxu indifferente & collaterali
moveat, ita ut tam[?] possint homines ea mala
non facere, quam facere; & Dei motio ni-
hil momenti afferet ad actualem efficaciam
in his malis.

page.notes: The right page edge carries printer's ornaments and show-through only; none transcribed. "tam" is followed by a superscript mark I could not identify with certainty, so it is marked [?]. The running head "C.2." is read as printed, with the numeral 2 as a small form. The section number at the foot is treated as a catchword for the next section.
